items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He was a regular member. [INTERVIEWEE] He was. He was.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. It looked like I said. If that other band wouldn't have... Some of the fellas drifted like me. I went and played with Clayton because he was in the jazz field with the Dixieland, you see. And he was playing a lot more, getting a lot more work than they were. Because they had a big band. Yes.
See how many are in there? Was Cook a regular member? Did he just sing with you sometimes as an entertainer? Or was he a regular member? He was a regular member.
